Container.Name: flaresolverr
Container.Overview: FlareSolverr, which Prowlarr uses for indexers behind a browser check. Generated by Lodestar. Start gluetun first. In Unraid's Docker autostart list, put gluetun above this container and set gluetun's wait to at least 30 seconds, so its firewall is on before this one starts. Applying it replaces a container or template you already have with the same name: check first.
